New Staff Recruitment at Shivajiraje High School, Assanora!

Applications are invited for the position of Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS)** on a Regular basis.

Key Vacancy Details:

School: Shivajiraje High School, Kholpewadi, Sal, Assanora, Goa

Post: Multi-Tasking Staff (01 Vacancy - General Category)

Qualification: Class XII pass

Required Documents: Full bio-data, application, testimonials, valid Residence Certificate, Employment Card, and any other relevant certificates

How to Apply: Submit your application along with all required documents to the Chairman

Last Date to Apply: On or before 31st October 2026

Swipe left to check the official notification slides. Visit www.dailyjobsgoa.in to get complete application details and stay updated on daily job alerts across Goa!

📢 WE ARE HIRING – VIDHI DAGINA, MAPUSA MARKET!

Vidhi Dagina is looking for a female candidate to join their team as a Sales Girl cum Store Administrator.

📍 Location: Mapusa Market, Goa
💼 Position: Sales Girl cum Store Administrator
💰 Salary: ₹10,000 per month + 2% incentive on monthly sales
🕒 Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM (with 1-hour lunch break)

Key Responsibilities:
• Handling customer inquiries and selling jewellery
• Marketing and billing
• Managing invoices
• Assisting with day-to-day store operations

Requirements:
✔️ Good communication skills
✔️ Honest, responsible and punctual
✔️ Basic computer knowledge
✔️ Experience preferred, but freshers can also apply

📲 Interested candidates can send their CV details via WhatsApp to 9011991739.

📢 RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION | NAVY CHILDREN SCHOOL, DABOLIM, GOA

Navy Children School, Dabolim, Goa, invites applications for the academic year 2027–28 for the following teaching positions:

🔹 PGT: Geography, Biology & Physics
🔹 TGT: English & Science (Biology)
🔹 PRT: Hindi

📌 Eligibility Highlights:
• Age limit: 21–50 years as on 1 July of the relevant academic year.
• Relevant postgraduate/graduate qualifications and B.Ed. or equivalent, as specified for each post.
• Teaching experience in CBSE schools is preferred for several positions.

📝 Selection Process: Written Test, Interview & Demo Class.

📅 Last Date to Apply: 16 November 2026
📍 Location: Dabolim, Goa

Shortlisted candidates will be called for the written test on 5 December 2026.

📩 Download and print the prescribed teacher application form. Submit the duly filled form to the school office or email a scanned copy to careersncsgoa@gmail.com

Please refer to the official recruitment notification for detailed post-wise eligibility criteria and application instructions before applying.
